homeDescription: ALD electrodes, optoelectronics, flexible devices, and future electronic integration.
question: How do thin-film interfaces, processing conditions, and material properties translate into electrical performance and reliability?
whatIControl: Thin-film electrode and contact design · printed-film thickness and trace geometry
whatIMeasure: Device transport and leakage · initial trace-to-trace variability · electrical response under repeated deformation
whyItMatters: Separating processing variation from operating stress clarifies which material and geometric changes matter in working devices.
foundationText: Organic and hybrid optoelectronics and printed stretchable interconnects provide connected experimental foundations. Oxide electronics and integrated devices are future interests, not completed platforms.
alt: Conceptual artwork of a thin-film electronic stack and molecular interface; not an experimental image
caption: Conceptual scientific artwork
